entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manisha Chaturvedi
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit filed in the Court today, is kept on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 150 of
2019, under Sections 498A, 304 B Ipc and Section 3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Kotwali Nagar,
District Aligarh, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared for informant.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Applicant is husband of the deceased and their Shahid vs State Of U.P. on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119512601/
1 marriage has taken place in the year, 2014.
The allegation that the deceased was being harassed on account of dowry, is wholly false.

Learned counsel has referred the statements of some independent witnesses, who have inter alia stated that the deceased put herself on fire by pouring kerosene and after that the applicant has also reached at the spot.
Statement of P. W. 3 Dr. Praveen Ranjan was referred, who has inter alia stated that the possibility that the deceased might have committed suicide, cannot be ruled out.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 16.5.2019 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than four years and nine months.
The applicant has no criminal history and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.

5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and that there is evidence that deceased was being harassed on account of demand of dowry.
The deceased has suffered 90% burns over her body.
At the time of alleged incident deceased was having pregnancy of four months, which is supported by medical evidence.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, the bail application of applicant-accused is hereby rejected.

7. However, keeping in view of the period of incarceration of applicant-accused, it is directed that the Trial Court shall expedite the trial and to decide the same as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of seven months from the date of production of certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.

Order Date :- 16.2.2024 HR  Shahid vs State Of U.P. on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119512601/
